Louisa May Alcott, Behind a Mask.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/louisa-may-alcott/behind-a-mask

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Louisa May Alcott, the author, died 1888.

First publication of the text used: 1866 (SE colophon: 'Behind a Mask was published in 1866 by Louisa May Alcott.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1866, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1961.
- Country of origin (the facts do not name the country of first publication): the last person to die did so in 1888. The text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, from 1 January 1989.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
